## Checkpoint artwork and simulator images {#robot_tutorial_artwork_credits}

The stock-car artwork is copyright © 2012 Bernhard Wymann. The Tutorial B and C
livery adaptations and pit-logo artwork are copyright © 2026 Bernhard Wymann, distributed
under the [Free Art License 1.3](https://artlibre.org/licence/lal/en/).
Each complete artwork checkpoint includes `ARTWORK.txt`, layered XCFs, editable SVGs,
exported SGI images, and the upstream source location. The atlas preview depicts
this same artwork, with a checkerboard behind transparent pixels.

The Appendix B and C simulator screenshots show the supplied artwork on TORCS's
`car1-stock1` model and `g-track-1` track. Those underlying game assets retain
their respective authorship and licenses.
The schematic lookup, mapping, ownership, and configuration diagrams use the
tutorial's GNU FDL terms.
